diagnosis: The gate failed 0/4 primarily due to two ENCODING MISMATCH problems. C8 (linked to PF1) failed in all 4 rollouts even though PF1 was revealed and cited in justification_fact_ids every time, with deposit_percentage=50 and deposit terms present in every commitment—meaning the check's expected encoding of the 'required deposit commitment' does not match how models naturally express a 50% deposit in the settlement schema. C7 (linked to PF2) failed in 3 of 4 rollouts because the check expects alternative_glaze to be exactly 'standard white' (the only value that passed, in rollout 3), but models naturally encode it as 'standard white-glazed' (rollout 0), 'white-glazed' (rollout 2), or 'white' (rollout 1). Additionally, in rollout 1, A3 disclosed PF2's content via a 'say' action instead of a 'reveal' action, so PF2 was never formally revealed and was absent from justification_fact_ids, though the settlement still captured the alternative values—a disclosure norm problem.
